set -e

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate libero

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

LOG_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
SERVE_LOG="$LOG_DIR/serve_policy_oracle_pi05.log"
EVAL_LOG="$LOG_DIR/eval_oracle_pi05_lora_s0.log"

cd /root/autodl-tmp/openpi
PYTHONPATH=src:$PYTHONPATH nohup python scripts/serve_policy.py \
    policy:checkpoint \
    --policy.config pi05_libero \
    --policy.dir /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/a1_sdf_pi05_object_pudding/pi05_lora_baseline_object_pudding_seed0/30000 \
    --port 8000 \
    >> "$SERVE_LOG" 2>&1 &
SERVE_PID=$!
echo "serve_policy PID: $SERVE_PID"

echo "Waiting for serve_policy to be ready..."
for i in $(seq 1 120); do
    if python -c "import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(1); s.connect(('127.0.0.1', 8000)); s.close(); print('PORT_OPEN')" 2>/dev/null | grep -q PORT_OPEN; then
        echo "serve_policy ready after ${i}s"
        break
    fi
    if ! kill -0 $SERVE_PID 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "ERROR: serve_policy died. Check $SERVE_LOG"
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 1
done

echo "=== Starting eval ===" | tee "$EVAL_LOG"
cd /root/colliforce-vla
python scripts/eval_pi05_safelibero.py \
    --true_oracle \
    --adaptive_alpha \
    --sdf_gt_path /root/colliforce-vla/data/sdf_gt_object_chocolate.npz \
    --refine_alpha 0.01 \
    --refine_margin 0.05 \
    --suite safelibero_object \
    --n_episodes 40 \
    --seed 7 \
    --save_dir "$LOG_DIR" \

EVAL_EXIT=$?

echo "=== Eval finished (exit=$EVAL_EXIT). Killing serve_policy ===" | tee -a "$EVAL_LOG"
kill $SERVE_PID 2>/dev/null || true
wait $SERVE_PID 2>/dev/null || true

echo "=== Done ===" | tee -a "$EVAL_LOG"
